The '''Second Skin Armor''' was a type of [[Armored Clothing|armored clothing]] that provided moderate protection while allowing for flexibility and easy movement. Unlike most other [[Armor/Legends|armors]], it was extremely thin and could be concealed beneath looser, non-protective [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], making it nearly undetectable. However, its lightweight design came at a high cost without offering significantly greater protection.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Second Skin Armor was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
